title: Core spine: service registry, contact identity, session auth, i18n
delivered: defineService wrapper: permission → validation → transaction → audit-in-tx → post-commit bus
Service composition via ctx.call / ctx.callAsSystem, sharing one transaction
Contact spine with a unique-email identity rule, contacts.resolve and contacts.merge
Owner registration guaranteed once by a partial unique index; token-scoped logout
i18n string layer with BCP-47 fallback chain and per-currency minor units
Boot sequence: core manifest, topo-sorted wiring, service registration and listener subscription, entered from instrumentation.ts
Production environment asserted at boot rather than at first login
Service-layer gate (§15.5) extended to the Drizzle client and driver
Type-aware lint, with the money gate (§15.4) expressed as lint rules
License-header gate enforcing the AGPL/MIT boundary in CI
Test harness: TEST_DATABASE_URL isolation, migrations in globalSetup, 92 tests
openFollowUps: contacts.resolve never updates an existing contact: a returning form submission's new phone/locale/source is silently discarded (§4.6 names contact_create/update)
contacts.merge orphans the duplicate's users row when both contacts have a login
No expired-session sweep: rows are deleted only when revisited, revoked, or cascaded (needs core/jobs)
Post-commit event bus is in-process, so events are lost if the process dies mid-publish
updatedAt is hand-maintained in contacts.update only; other write paths will drift
TimelineEventInput.subjectId is typed string against a uuid column
tests/helpers/spine.ts hand-lists spine tables while src/core/tables.ts is the barrel — they will drift
License-header gate does not cover CSS (needs block-comment handling)
Boot mounts no routes, jobs or MCP tools — no such surfaces exist yet
The FX-inside-charge-paths half of the money gate (§15.4) awaits an fx adapter

title: The HTTP edge: actor resolution, service routes, auth endpoints
delivered: src/core/http: cookies, actor resolution, ServiceError-to-status mapping, serviceRoute wrapper
Framework-agnostic (web Request/Response) so src/ stays free of Next imports
Routes: POST /api/setup/owner, /api/auth/login, /api/auth/logout, GET /api/auth/session
Session token lives only in an HttpOnly SameSite=Lax cookie, never in a response body
Sliding session renewal re-issues the cookie so the browser copy cannot expire first
Verified end to end over real HTTP against the dev database, not only as function calls
openFollowUps: No CSRF defence beyond SameSite=Lax; state-changing routes need a token before browser forms post with cookie auth
No rate limiting on login or setup — brute force is currently unbounded
No middleware yet for locale routing or noindex headers on /admin and /portal
Cookie is re-issued only by GET /api/auth/session; other routes let it drift toward expiry

title: Business settings, module toggles, and CSRF defence
delivered: business_profile singleton, enforced by a check constraint rather than convention
Column-level checks on country, currency and first day of week
settings services: getBusiness, setupState, updateBusiness, patchBusiness, completeSetup
Module toggles, with core refused so an owner cannot lock themselves out
Setup locks after completion so the wizard cannot be replayed on a live site
CSRF double-submit token, enforced in serviceRoute for cookie-authenticated writes
audit_log.subject_id and timeline_events.subject_id are now text: subjects are polymorphic
openFollowUps: No rate limiting on login or setup — brute force is still unbounded
settings.listModules returns only stored rows; the admin screen must merge with the boot report
No /setup or admin UI yet — these services have no screens
Logo and branding await core/media
Regenerating an applied migration requires resetting the target database; worth a documented reset script

title: Design system (Bench) and the first-run setup wizard
delivered: src/core/design/tokens.ts: semantic colour roles, type scale, spacing, radii, motion — plain data, no framework
Tokens emitted as CSS custom properties by the layout at request time, per §32
Tailwind theme references the variables, so a brand override reaches every utility
Self-hosted Schibsted Grotesk + JetBrains Mono, latin and latin-ext, with OFL licences
Phosphor icons (React and React Native packages exist, so web and app stay consistent)
src/ui primitives: Card, Field, Input, Select, Segmented, Button, Callout, Pill
Three-step /setup wizard on Server Actions, working before any JavaScript loads
Country-driven smart defaults for currency, timezone, units and week start (§13 step 3)
Contrast tests asserting WCAG AA across every pairing in both schemes
Verified end to end in a browser: owner created, business saved, wizard locked
Light/dark/system as a platform standard: cookie-backed, resolved server-side, stamped on <html>
No flash of the wrong theme — the preference is in the first byte, not applied after hydration
Theme switch works with JavaScript disabled (three submit buttons, one server action)
color-scheme narrowed per theme so native controls follow the choice, not the OS
Fixed instrumentation.ts being evaluated in the Edge runtime, where core cannot load node:crypto
openFollowUps: No admin shell yet — settings have a wizard but no screen to edit them afterwards
Radix is the agreed primitive but nothing needs it yet; it lands with the first menu or dialog
Locale list is derived from the country default, not chosen by the owner
Setup covers §13 steps 1-3; payments, modules and demo data steps wait on those modules
No logo upload — waits on core/media
packages/templates is still a scaffold; the Bench tokens should become its first theme
Theme toggle is only in the setup header; it belongs in the admin shell and, as an owner opt-in, on the public site

title: Admin shell: sign-in, overview, and editable settings
delivered: (admin) route group: /login outside the guard, /admin behind it
requireStaffActor() called by the layout AND every page, because Next renders them in parallel
Sign-in and sign-out through the auth services; sign-out revokes the session row
Overview with real contact counts and the real audit trail, rendered in plain English
Settings screen editing the business profile after setup
events.recentActivity and contacts.stats services
noindex on admin and login (§5)
Full IANA timezone and ISO currency lists, with withCurrent() so a stored value is always selectable
openFollowUps: No contacts screen yet — the spine is counted but not browsable
Audit entries show the service name prettified; a real human-readable summary per action would read better
No staff invitations, so the only account is the owner created at setup
Sign-in has no rate limiting (tracked since the HTTP edge landed)
No password reset or OTP yet

title: Contacts in the admin: list, detail, timeline, create and edit
delivered: Contacts list with search, stage filter and paging, all as GET params so a view is a URL
contacts.list now returns { rows, total } — paging needs a total the page length cannot give
contacts.timeline service: the CRM timeline as a view over the spine (§4.1)
Contact detail with inline edit and its timeline
Create by hand, with the unique-email conflict surfaced in plain English
Fixed: React resets a form after every action, so a rejected save discarded everything typed
Fixed: the duplicate-email message named internal services to a business owner
openFollowUps: The setup owner form still loses its email on a rejected submit — same React form-reset cause
No merge UI: contacts.merge exists as a service but the admin cannot call it
No contact delete or archive
Timeline shows core events only; module events arrive with their modules
Search has no index behind it — fine at this size, needs one before it is not

title: Merge duplicates from the contact detail screen
delivered: Merge panel on contact detail: search for the duplicate rather than a dropdown of everyone
Owner-only, and hidden from staff rather than shown and refused
Closes the gap where the duplicate-email message suggested merging but nothing could
openFollowUps: Merge has no confirmation step and cannot be undone
No way to merge from the list by selecting two rows

title: Storage adapters: S3-compatible, Replit, and local
delivered: StorageAdapter contract with put/get/delete/url and an explicit isPublic
S3-compatible implementation covering Spaces, R2, MinIO, B2 and AWS via aws4fetch
Replit Object Storage via dynamic import, so its package never burdens other deploys
Local filesystem for development, with a path guard against key traversal
Selection from freeholder.config.ts; missing S3 credentials fail loudly rather than falling back to disk
storageKey() sanitises attacker-influenced filenames; 15 tests including traversal and signing
openFollowUps: No consumer yet — the Asset table, media services and admin library are the next PR
No image variants; sharp is already allowed to build in pnpm-workspace.yaml for that
No presigned upload straight from the browser, so uploads pass through the app for now
@replit/object-storage is not in optionalDependencies yet; a Replit deploy must add it
